title: A device signed in to the admin app stays signed in for ever, even if nobody opens it for months
what: Once a phone or computer signs in to the gym's admin app, its sign-in never runs out. A desk tablet sold, a laptop left at a branch that closed, or an owner's old phone that has not opened the app for six months still opens the gym's records and money the day it is used again. Only removing the person or pressing sign out ends it. MettleUp's own HQ page already treats a device unseen for 30 days as no longer live, but the server still lets it in.
expected: A sign-in that has not been used for a long time (for example 90 days) stops working and asks for a new code; a desk device in daily use stays signed in.
how_often: whenever an old or lost device is used again
fix_line: End a sign-in that has not been used for a set number of days and ask for a fresh code

title: Running an older database step again quietly undoes a later one, and can break Create my gym
what: Database steps are pasted in by hand and each says it is safe to run again. Two are not safe on their own: running the support-access step again takes the trial and plan out of HQ's gym page and the owner's MettleUp access list, and running the receipt-rules step again puts back the old Create my gym door next to the new one, so a call from the admin app can match both and Create my gym fails. The only guard is a sentence in the file header; nothing checks the order or warns.
expected: Re-running any step leaves the database as the latest steps left it, or the step refuses to run when a later step is already in place.
how_often: only if someone runs an old step again
fix_line: Make older steps skip what a later step replaced, and add a cloud check that runs every step twice in order

title: A member who joins today sees up to two weeks of the gym's older messages marked unread
what: On purpose, a new app member is shown the gym's messages from the 14 days before they joined, so they still see notices like a Sunday closing. But every one of them arrives marked unread and counted as unread, even notices whose day has already passed and offers that have ended. On the member's first day the inbox looks full of new news that is in fact old.
expected: Messages sent before the member joined can be shown, but without the unread mark and outside the unread count.
how_often: every new member of a gym that sent messages in the last 2 weeks
fix_line: Treat messages older than the member's join time as already seen

items.reason: Fresh install: cloud CI applies every step on an empty database. Update: existing gyms got trial dates by a backfill; replaced server doors keep old calls working through optional extras, so an old admin page left open still works. Fault: re-running old steps. Phone, watch, sideload and Play parts do not apply to database steps.

Trial and plan end lock nothing by design; India time used for every day; the 13 May 2027 log-keeping switch matches the privacy page; staff removal ends their sessions; an owner who lost every device has HQ's code reset. Faults: sign-ins never expire (new); the server plan-end rule repeats the short month-end plan; a member returning on a new phone becomes a second member; a paused gym still takes joins; branch trial extension.

Trial: existing gyms back-filled. Terms: existing owners asked at next sign-in. My membership: members without a check-in number get a path by checking in once. Branches: every existing member starts without the every-branch tick.
For branches the only path is ticking each member one by one.
Rule applied; the branch case is already a finding.
The only new-mark this area holds is the member inbox unread state.
New member: old messages unread (new). Rejoin on a new phone: read messages unread again (existing).
